name: opencodex-agent
description: A free, open-source coding agent inside VS Code.

opencodex.model.description: Selected free model ID for the active provider. Choose it from the sidebar.

opencodex.provider.description: Model provider to use. OpenCode works anonymously; the other built-in providers need an API key saved in Settings (or a matching environment variable). Can also be the id of a custom OpenAI-compatible provider added in Settings.

opencodex.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-loop steps per request. Set to 0 for unlimited tasks.

opencodex.approvalMode.description: Controls whether file edits and commands require confirmation. 'Auto edits' still asks before destructive commands; 'Open access' runs everything without confirmation.

opencodex.searxngUrl.description: Base URL for a SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled. Defaults to a local instance on port 8888; leave empty to disable web search.

opencodex.youcomApiKey.description: Optional You.com API key used by the web-search tool when no SearXNG URL is configured. Get a key at https://you.com/platform/api-keys. Can also be provided with the YDC_API_KEY environment variable. Leave empty to disable.

opencodex.mcpServers.description: JSON object of MCP servers. Each entry may use an HTTP/SSE URL or a stdio command with args, env, and cwd.

opencodex.extraFreeModels.description: Comma-separated model IDs to treat as free for the selected provider, in addition to the ones detected automatically.

opencodex.systemNotifications.description: Show native Opencodex system notifications (task completed, approval needed, task failed) when VS Code is not focused.

opencodex.worktrees.description: Enable isolated Git worktrees/branches for parallel tasks with a monitor/compare/merge/discard dashboard.

opencodex.browserTesting.description: Enable Playwright-based browser testing (DOM and accessibility inspection, clicks/typing, console/network capture, responsive geometry, screenshots).

opencodex.githubWorkflows.description: Enable GitHub issue-to-PR workflows: branches, commits, PR creation, CI monitoring, and review-comment fixes.

opencodex.shadowCheckpoints.description: Capture a persistent shadow-Git checkpoint after every edit or command, including untracked files, with comparison and selective restore.

opencodex.repoIndex.description: Enable incremental repository indexing, semantic/symbol search, architecture mapping, and source-cited memory.

opencodex.customAgents.description: Enable user-defined custom agents with their own prompts, models, tool permissions, skills, MCP servers, and automatic routing.

opencodex.tasksHooks.description: Enable scheduled/event-triggered tasks and pre/post-tool hooks for policies, validation, and logging.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package
